description: This file contains a fake implementation of the IHostApplicationLifetime interface for unit testing purposes. It provides methods to simulate starting and stopping an application, and manages cancellation tokens accordingly.

classes.name: FakeHostApplicationLifetime
classes.description: A fake implementation of IHostApplicationLifetime for unit testing, managing application lifecycle events via cancellation tokens.

methods.name: StartApplication
methods.description: Simulates starting the application by cancelling the ApplicationStarted token.

methods.name: StopApplication
methods.description: Simulates stopping the application by cancelling the ApplicationStopping and ApplicationStopped tokens.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the internal CancellationTokenSource objects.
